claims.text: A local Windows desktop app. Chat builds, checks and runs OLGA cases. Writes, saves and runs wait for an approval card.
Product version 0.1.5. Installer name on the v0.1.5 release notes is OLGA-Companion_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe, plus an msi. Unsigned. Compare SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS.txt.
Windows x64. Needs a licensed OLGA for real runs. OLGA is not bundled. Tested with OLGA 2022.1.
OpenAI (Codex), GitHub Copilot, Antigravity (Gemini), xAI (Grok), or an API key.
Each approval works once and expires after ten minutes.
npm run dev:app serves the frontend on port 5273 and the sidecar on port 8865.
Build from source needs Node.js 22.12+ and Python 3.11+.
Apache-2.0. The pvt_engine folder is MIT.

Public sample: water 4 kg/s, air 0.05 kg/s, 1.5 km, 120 mm ID, outlet 4 bar(a), 30 C. Proposed feed 4.05 kg/s, water fraction 0.987654, roughness 4.5e-5 m, 50 sections, 3600 s. Result 447916.6 Pa to 400423.8 Pa, drop 47492.8 Pa.
Bundled generic air-water table, label AIR_WATER, 0-80 C, 0.5-20 bar. The shipped table file names CPA.
